The institutional investor held 486,077 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.52 million, down from 787,239 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Connor Clark & Lunn Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Ocwen Financial Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $626.72 million market cap company.
